jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Trust Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Company 

Credit Genie is a mobile-first financial wellness platform designed to help individuals take control of their financial future. We leverage artificial intelligence to provide personalized insights and are building a financial ecosystem by offering tools and services that provide instant access to cash, and building credit. Our goal is to empower every customer to achieve long-term financial stability.


Founded in 2019 by Ed Harycki, former Swift Capital Founder (acquired by PayPal in 2017). Backed by Khosla Ventures and led by industry pioneers from companies such as; PayPal, Square, and Cash App, we are well positioned to build the future of inclusive finance through cutting-edge technology and customer-centric solutions.

Overview

As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Trust Platform team, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the systems that safeguard and personalize our financial products. You'll design and build the core services that power fraud detection, authentication, decisioning, and customer data. This is a rare chance to join a fast-growing fintech startup where your work will have a direct and meaningful impact on both the company and the financial well-being of our users.

What You'll Do

  • Design, Build, and Scale – Own backend systems end-to-end, from architecture to deployment, building high-performance, secure, and reusable services that product teams rely on to manage risk and deliver consistent customer experiences.

  • Greenfield Development – Work on new capabilities from scratch - whether that's a next-generation fraud signal pipeline, a unified notifications service, or an intelligent decisioning layer - making foundational technical decisions that will shape our platform for years to come.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Partner with product, design, data science, and adjacent engineering teams to build trust and safety features that balance rigorous risk management with a seamless user experience.

  • Technical Leadership – Lead critical technical and design discussions across fraud detection, authentication, and customer data domains, driving best practices in system design, coding, testing, and DevOps.

  • Customer-Focused Innovation – Scope, build, and optimize intelligent services that protect users from fraud while ensuring every interaction feels secure, personalized, and trustworthy.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling high-performance backend systems in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. 

  • Expertise in architecting and productionizing large-scale distributed systems.

  • Comfortable working across multiple technical areas and collaborating with frontend/mobile teams.

  • Passion for tackling complex challenges with structured thinking and analytical rigor. Ability to break down intricate systems, identify flaws, and implement scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, iterative environment with a bias for action. Excited to take full ownership of projects, drive impact, and work cross-functionally with product, design, and engineering teams.

  • Strong understanding of data privacy, compliance, and secure coding practices. Experience with designing resilient and reliable systems that meet high security and regulatory standards.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with products related to lending, credit cards, payments, or other financial services.

  • Familiarity with mobile app ecosystems and financial technology

Benefits and Perks

Our goal is to provide a comprehensive offering of benefits and perks that promote better financial, mental, and physical wellness.

We believe working alongside each other in person is the best way to build a great product and foster a strong company culture. Our expectation is that employees are in the office five days a week, allowing for optimal collaboration, inclusivity, and productivity. At the same time, we understand that life happens and recognize the importance of flexibility. We are committed to supporting our employees when circumstances arise that require remote work or adjusted schedules. Our goal is to ensure everyone can effectively balance personal and professional responsibilities while maintaining our collaborative and productive environment.

Here are some highlights of our benefits and perks offerings, feel free to ask your recruiting partner for more details on our comprehensive offering for employees.

  • 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents on your first day of employment. 

  • Receive up to $100 per month in fitness reimbursement or enjoy a complimentary full membership to LifeTime Fitness or Equinox.

  • 401(k) with a 3.5% match and immediate vesting 

  • Meal program available for both lunch and dinner

  • Pre-tax benefits, including a $1,000 HSA match

  • Life and accidental insurance

  • Flexible PTO

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total compensation and rewards package at Credit Genie. You may also be eligible to participate in the bonus and equity programs. You will also have access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan with company match, short & long term disability insurance, life insurance, and flexible PTO along with many other benefits and perks.

Credit Genie is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer where we welcome and celebrate differences. We are committed to providing a workspace that is safe and inclusive, where everyone feels supported, connected, and inspired to do their best work. If you require any accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, please inform us of your needs when we contact you to schedule an interview.

Overview

The Financial Platform team owns the systems that move money at Credit Genie and the connections that make it possible: cash advances, repayments, refunds, bank account linking, debit card management, and the ledgering and reconciliation that keep every dollar accounted for. When these systems are wrong, customers lose money and trust; when they are right, nobody notices. That is the bar.

As the Staff Engineer on this team, you will set the technical direction for our money movement platform and raise the engineering bar for the team around you. You will own the hardest correctness and scale problems we have, make the foundational architecture decisions that the platform will live with for years, and be the engineer the rest of the team looks to for how quality work gets done. This is a rare chance to join a fast-growing fintech startup where your work directly protects and improves the financial well-being of our users.

 

What You'll Do

  • Set the Technical Direction: Own the architecture and long-term technical roadmap for our money movement systems. Drive the decisions on how we structure payment orchestration, ledgering, and reconciliation as transaction volume grows, and see those decisions through to production.

  • Build Financial Systems That Are Provably Correct: Design for the properties money movement demands: idempotent operations, exactly-once semantics, auditable state transitions, automated reconciliation, and invariant monitoring that catches discrepancies before customers do.

  • Design, Build, and Scale: Own backend systems end-to-end, from architecture through deployment and production operation, ensuring high performance, security, and scalability as our financial products grow.

  • Raise the Bar for the Team: Set the standard for engineering quality across the Financial Platform team. Lead design reviews, mentor senior and mid-level engineers, and establish practices for testing, observability, and operational excellence that outlast any single project.

  • Own the Bank and Card Integrations: Own the platform's connections to the outside financial world: bank account linking through data aggregators, debit card lifecycle management, and processor integrations. Build abstractions that keep these third-party dependencies reliable, observable, and swappable.

  • Own Production: Treat reliability of money movement as a first-class engineering problem. Lead incident response for the platform, drive post-incident hardening, and build the monitoring and safeguards that make failures rare and recoverable.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product, compliance, risk, data science, and our banking and processor partners to ship features that balance speed to market with the rigor regulated money movement requires.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling high-performance backend systems in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Direct experience building and operating financial platform systems at scale: payments, money movement, lending, ledgering, billing, or banking infrastructure handling high volumes of real customer funds.

  • Deep fluency in the correctness patterns financial software demands: idempotency, distributed transactions, double-entry accounting, reconciliation, retry safety, and auditability.

  • A track record of setting technical direction for a team: you have owned the architecture of a significant system, driven the roadmap to evolve it, and brought other engineers along through design reviews and mentorship.

  • High ownership as a default. You treat the systems you build as yours end-to-end, from design through incident response, and you raise problems and fix them without waiting to be asked.

  • Expertise in architecting and productionizing large-scale distributed systems.

  • Strong understanding of data privacy, compliance, and secure coding practices, with experience designing resilient, reliable systems that meet high security and regulatory standards.

  • Structured thinking and analytical rigor. You break down intricate systems, identify flaws, and implement scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with payment rails and partners: ACH, RTP, card networks, push-to-debit, or direct processor and bank integrations.

  • Experience with bank data aggregators (Plaid, MX, Finicity) or card issuing and debit card management platforms.

  • Experience in regulated consumer fintech (lending, credit, or banking products).

  • Experience with event-driven architectures and TypeScript/Node.js services.

  • Experience leading incident response and building invariant or anomaly monitoring for financial data.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to raise the quality and velocity of a team, not just your own output.

 - Own a product space end-to-end. Take an ambiguous, large area spanning multiple features discovery through ship through post-launch iteration and drive it with minimal supervision.

 - Decompose ambiguity into a plan. Turn open-ended problems into a sequenced set of bets the team can actually execute against, and get alignment on the problem before the solution.

 - Set the craft bar. Make the call between "good enough for now" and "needs to be right" and say which one you're choosing and why, out loud, so the team can calibrate.

 - Shape the system, not just the screens. Identify patterns to promote, unify, or deprecate across the product, and partner on shipping new components and retiring old ones. We're building a design system from scratch for our new brand while maintaining one for Credit Genie.

 - Bring the right methodology. Scrappy when speed and learning matter; thorough when quality and stakes are high. In a regulated fintech, knowing which mode a problem calls for is the skill.

 - Influence the roadmap. Help shape what the team takes on. Connect design choices to business strategy and make the case for design-led opportunities rather than waiting to be assigned them.

 - Be a trusted advisor cross-functionally. Build alignment across competing perspectives before they become blockers, so stakeholders are never surprised by a design decision.

 - Tell the story. Write and present crisp narratives that move work forward with peers and with leadership. Make complex work legible.

 - Mentor with intent. Invest deliberately in mid-level designers, real feedback, real growth and model the standards you expect from others.

The Director of Compliance manages and maintains the company's compliance program, ensuring regulatory and legal adherence while enabling the business to build consumer-facing financial products efficiently. Reporting to the Head of Legal, this person translates compliance strategy into day-to-day execution and helps integrate regulatory requirements into product and business decisions without unnecessary friction. Because our products are used directly by consumers, they keep consumer protection, fair treatment, and disclosure obligations at the center of the compliance program.

This person is responsible for the effectiveness of the compliance program as it adapts to regulatory developments, business growth, and product expansion. They give the Head of Legal and senior management clear visibility into the company's compliance posture: reporting on program performance, risk trends, and emerging regulatory issues, and helping prepare materials for the Board of Directors.

  • Maintain and operate a compliance framework that allows the company to build and scale consumer financial products within legal and regulatory guidelines.

  • Track regulatory developments across consumer finance and adapt the compliance program to stay ahead of potential challenges.

  • Own compliance review of consumer-facing touchpoints — product flows, disclosures, marketing, fee structures, and customer communications — to ensure they meet UDAAP, fair lending, and disclosure standards.

  • Support engagement with regulators, industry groups, auditors, and financial institution partners under the direction of the Head of Legal.

  • Build scalable compliance processes that grow with the company's expansion into new markets and product lines.

  • Work hand-in-hand with product, engineering, and design teams to embed compliance into the product design process early, not just as a final approval step.

  • Advise on structuring products to balance compliance with customer experience and market competitiveness.

  • Help manage consumer complaint monitoring and remediation, using patterns in customer feedback to identify and address compliance risk.

  • Keep compliance processes lightweight and efficient, reducing operational friction.

  • Prepare clear, data-driven compliance reporting on program effectiveness, regulatory trends, and key risk areas to inform management decisions and support Board reporting.

  • Help foster a compliance-minded culture where teams see regulations as guardrails for smart innovation rather than roadblocks.

  • Educate employees on practical compliance principles rather than overwhelming them with rigid policies.

  • Work cross-functionally with legal, risk, finance, and operations to align compliance activities with business objectives.

  • Experience supporting or implementing AML/KYC programs, with knowledge of the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), OFAC requirements, and FinCEN guidance.

  • Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply regulations pragmatically, enabling compliant solutions that support innovation and user experience.

  • Experience working with regulatory bodies, auditors, and financial institution partners, with a credible communication style.

  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with product, engineering, legal, and operations to embed compliance into the product lifecycle.

  • Familiarity with tooling for transaction monitoring, case management, and reporting.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey compliance risks and requirements to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Receive up to $100 per month in fitness reimbursement or enjoy a complimentary full membership to LifeTime Fitness or Equinox.

  • 401(k) with a 3.5% match and immediate vesting 

  • Meal program available for both lunch and dinner

  • Pre-tax benefits, including a $1,000 HSA match

  • Life and accidental insurance

Base salary is just one part of your total compensation and rewards package at Credit Genie. You may also be eligible to participate in the bonus and equity programs.
